summary: Added `aic run-weekly --week YYYY-Www` for bounded historical replays. The runner derives an America/Los_Angeles Monday start and inclusive Sunday-night endpoint, rejects invalid and future weeks before source fetch, records the target week and bounds in run diagnostics, and preserves current-week behavior when omitted. Evidence: focused tests -> 16 passed; full suite -> 94 passed; live `uv run aic run-weekly --week 2026-W29` completed successfully with 22 new raw artifacts, 13 new Codex packets, nine successful sources, four healthy-empty sources, and diagnostics at data/runs/20260725T213053Z-run-weekly-14254a. Four Codex-authored insights were imported, then `aic brief --week 2026-W29` and `aic belief-update --week 2026-W29` produced a source-grounded brief and updated the belief ledger.
